$Comment: Student: the title the achievement mastery_trainer_friendly pays once a player reaches Student (Friendly) with the Mastery Trainer, the first of six rank titles in this folder (the seventh, Grandmaster, ships in MMO Skill Tree itself). It shows beside a player's name in menus and leaderboards once they pick it. Its name, its flavor and where it sits around the name are the keys title.mmo_mastery_student.name, .flavor and .display (whose {0} is the name). Order sorts it in the title picker, the rank titles together in rank order; Enabled false hides it everywhere without taking it from anybody who earned it.
